groups.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Google approved client/audience/brand/domain and login-only scopes match the selected staging environment.

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Provider-to-Supabase callback and Supabase-to-app callback are separately registered; wrong environment/host is rejected.

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Authorization opens in a permitted system/browser flow; cancellation preserves the prior account and workspace.

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Wrong issuer/audience, tampered ID token or mismatched nonce/state/verifier is rejected by the selected verified flow.

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Unverified or suspended account cannot acquire protected access; new social identity completes required profile/currency onboarding.

cases.title: Provider configuration and safe authentication
cases.expected: Disabled/misconfigured provider fails clearly while existing password sign-in and account data remain usable.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Verified same-email password/provider linking retains the original UUID, memberships, finance and subscriptions.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Unconfirmed same-email identity collision follows actual Auth server behavior without pre-account takeover or silent workspace grant.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Different email or Apple relay identity is linked only through an authenticated deliberate flow; no client-written UUID/email merge.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Wrong-account invitation denial holds through callback and direct completion RPC; invitation UUID alone grants nothing.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Existing/new Business invite requires deliberate acceptance with live role, scope, expiry and seat checks.

cases.title: Identity linking and invitation collisions
cases.expected: Unfinished/replaced/expired Admin invitation plus social login does not create an unintended Free workspace or cancel the selected plan.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Signup confirmation and resend show correct purpose/destination and deny unconfirmed protected sign-in.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Recovery opens only the intended identity, saves a password and handles newest/expired/replayed links correctly.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Admin new-user and unfinished-account resend emails describe setup and resolve to the guarded signup callback.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Business new and existing-user emails use Business-specific subjects/body for current Auth callbacks and retained legacy callbacks.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Generic magic-link mail remains generic; spoofed/lookalike/external callback never selects privileged-purpose copy or an unsafe redirect.

cases.title: Email purpose and callback compatibility
cases.expected: Two accounts/tabs, account switch, system-browser-to-PWA/native handoff and missing verifier preserve deliberate verified-account transfer.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Chosen iOS primary-account login complies with the reviewed 4.8 decision and any documented applicable exception.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Apple audience, Services/App IDs, capability and selected web/native nonce validation bind the right environment.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Hidden-email relay login retains the Auth UUID; invitation to a different real email remains pending rather than auto-merged.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Registered sender/return-path/DKIM configuration delivers to a controlled relay inbox; failure is observable without exposing link material.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Missing name on repeat sign-in does not overwrite a valid profile; required currencies/onboarding are completed.

cases.title: Apple option and relay compatibility
cases.expected: Provider revocation, unlink/alternate sign-in availability and applicable OAuth secret expiry/rotation preserve recovery.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: Existing SMTP route and approved purpose templates deliver to controlled inboxes with actual sender/domain authentication.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: Inactive hook does not shadow SMTP; any explicitly selected hook rollout proves routing and restoration of the previous route.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: Enabled HTTP hook rejects altered body, invalid signature, stale timestamp and unauthorized direct calls before dispatch.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: Supported action types and secure email-change old/new recipient/token mappings are exact; unknown action fails safely.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: Provider timeout/rate/bounce and duplicate/retry delivery have bounded, observable outcomes without reporting inbox delivery from API acceptance.

cases.title: Auth email delivery and hook boundary
cases.expected: OTP/token/hash/full links and credentials are absent from application analytics, shared mail queues and retained operational logs.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Application-email recipient, event and workspace scope are server-derived; forged caller recipient/body does not create mail.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Recipient membership/role and event validity are rechecked at dispatch, including revoked access and deleted/retained subjects.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Concurrent claim/retry/dedup and stale jobs have durable bounded semantics; provider ambiguity does not produce false delivered status.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Approved event types, per-recipient/global budgets, bounce suppression and preference rules prevent unwanted/cross-tenant mail.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Exact candidate/template/server settings parity, isolated actors/inboxes and rollback are verified before the bounded staging batch.

cases.title: Application email and rollout evidence
cases.expected: Final web/PWA/native matrix and provider/store declarations reconcile with earlier AU/AM/NR/privacy actions; retained fixtures remain unchanged.
